title: Super veteran takes up strategy role at NGS Super
full_text:
NGS Super has appointed WTW and superannuation industry veteran Nick Callil as head of strategy.
He previously spent 27 years at WTW including 15 years as head of retirement solutions, Australia.
In terms of the super industry, he also spent 14 years as a member of the Association of Superannuation Funds Australia (ASFA) until November 2024 including sitting on its Super System Design Council and chairing its annual conference committee.
In the role at NGS Super, he will help the $15 billion fund with development and execution of its future strategy as well as business planning and major growth initiatives.
“This appointment strengthens our strategic capability as we continue expanding our retirement offering to support members when it matters most,” the fund said.
“A recognised thought leader and regular speaker on retirement, Nick has authored a wide range of papers and articles focused on improving outcomes in the retirement phase of Australia’s super system. We’re excited to move forward with his perspective and expertise to deliver better outcomes for members.”
Writing on LinkedIn, Callil said: “Super excited to join NGS Super, serving our 112,000+ members and working with the outstanding NGS team led by Natalie Previtera. Looking forward to helping drive forward the fund’s strategic thinking and expand its retirement program, so that members can live a confident & dignified life in retirement.”
This is the second appointment in two months after it promoted Adam Parsons to chief member officer with responsibility for member growth, engagement and advice services.
Having joined NGS Super in 2024, Parsons previously led the fund’s brand, marketing and digital experience functions, helping reposition those areas as drivers of member acquisition, retention and engagement.
Before joining NGS Super, he held senior marketing leadership positions at Colonial First State and CommSec.
